text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 8, 2025) for 100 Wellesley Street East.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 8, 2025), for 100 Wellesley Street East, Folder No. 25 262810 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2026.
